snippet.title: Pirate Chips - Demo Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Pirate Chips, a Bat Sheep Crazy experience developed by a passionate team and made for the ones that need chaos and cooperation. Embark as a potato pirate, build your own boatato and sail to sea. 
Your objective ? You are a pirate ! So let’s shoot cannonballs, aboard other boatato and most importantly, be the last spudmate standing.
Join our Discord to discover more about the game: https://discord.gg/HwP3pm3Pfp
